Paytable

Pride & Trait Vault use Lazy Lions the operator holds: whole characters #2038 #1466 #1506 #3273 for premiums, and real trait close-ups for the rest — Spinner Hat, Gold Chain, Shades, Big Smile, then Crown (top low symbol), Hawaiian Shirt, Cigar and LAZY Hat.
Cub Cluster uses Lazy Cubs instead: #21095 and #3097, Cub LAZY Hat and Money Mouth, with Lazy Milk (higher) and Lazy Juice as the low pair.
WILD, the $LAZY scatter and the Lazy drinks are original art. WILD is still blocked by the licensing gate — none of the 73 owned Lions is a Signature Series. The drinks are canon in the collection's lore but are not traits on any token, so they carry no licensing dependency.
Play money only — no wallet, no $LAZY, no chain. Strip weights, paytables, win caps and the HMAC-SHA256 derivation are the verified production values.
